prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGES (attached in this order):
Image 1 = SCHEMATIC: the exact silhouette, size and position to fill
Image 2 = the base hero body: the design to keep

STYLE BIBLE v2 (cyber datacenter): hand-drawn comic-book 2D game art, chunky readable cartoon shapes, cel shading with 2-3 hard-edged tones and grain; even medium-weight ink outline in very dark navy (#061018) around every object and major interior forms.
Palette: almost-black blue-teal bodies and metals (#071016, #0e1a22, #1a2a33, #2a3a44), matte, low saturation; light-emitting details (screens, LED strips, edge strips, indicator dots, power cores, cable ends) painted as FLAT pale cyan (#bff8ff) or pale mint (#c9fff0) shapes with a thin cyan (#00e5ff) border, no glow; warning details only in yellow (#ffd600) with black stripes; nothing warm, no brown, no beige, no orange metal.
Light: dim cool ambient from above, key from the upper left, lit faces only slightly lighter; the cyan details are the brightest areas; no cast shadows painted on the ground.
Strict top-down 3/4 view, camera about 50 degrees above the ground, orthographic, objects show their top and their front face.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no glow, no light rays, no cast shadows, no frame.

ASSET:
Use case: ONE part — the BODY — of a hero SKIN for cut-out rig animation in a top-down 3/4 survivors-like game set inside a dark cyberpunk datacenter.
Image 1 is a SCHEMATIC of this part: a flat grey silhouette with a dark outline. Fill EXACTLY this outline: the same silhouette, the same size and position on the canvas, the same proportions. It shows no details.
Image 2 is the base hero Полная прослеживаемость's body: keep its design — the U body, the two cubes, the eyes and its ring orbit of three small link nodes around its top — so the skin is clearly the same character.
Skin: ПЕРЕХВАТ — an aggressive armoured variant: angular armour plating over the U with sharp chamfered edges and short swept-back fins on the cube tops; dark gunmetal (#262a33) armour with electric violet (#8f5bff) edge lights; the cubes armoured in gunmetal with an electric violet front plate; determined narrowed eyes with a confident grin; the orbit ring becomes a sharp segmented ring with three angular violet nodes like targeting markers.
Draw ONLY the body: no legs, no arms, the hip and shoulder areas closed and complete, facing the viewer.
Line and finish: crisp clean vector-like linework, one even thin dark navy outline (#0b1622) around every shape, smooth flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, NO grain, NO texture, NO noise, NO wobbly or blobby edges.
Constraints: one single part, centred, nothing else on the canvas, no text, no letters, no numbers, no ground, no shadow, no glow, transparent background, not cut by the canvas edge.

Canvas: 1536x1024 px (3:2 landscape); if that exact size is unavailable, use the closest size with the same aspect ratio.

Background: fully transparent (real alpha channel, PNG) everywhere outside the ASSET, with clean anti-aliased edges; no ground or cast shadow beyond what the ASSET describes, no frame, no checkerboard pattern
